title: feat: input-side image:png_base64_batch envelope
body:
## Summary

Closes the silent `tensor[0]` truncation bug for multi-image inputs: when a descriptor advertises `"png_base64_batch"` for an IMAGE input and the inbound tensor has `shape[0] > 1`, the encoder now emits a multi-frame envelope (`frames=[…]`) instead of dropping `tensor[1:]`. Lockstep with paired server PR — both must merge.

## Changes

### Client
- `serialization.py`: extend `encode_image_tensor` with an `accepts_batch=False` keyword. When True AND `tensor.shape[0] > 1`, emit `{"type":"image","encoding":"png_base64_batch","frames":[…],"shape":[B,H,W,C],…}` — same wire shape as the existing `_decode_image_batch_envelope` on the response path so both directions round-trip symmetrically. Default-False keeps the legacy single-frame contract for descriptors that haven't migrated.
- `proxy_node.py`: plumb the per-input `input_serialization` allow-list from `descriptor.remote.input_serialization` through `build_node_class` → `_execute_remote` → `_encode_inputs` → `_encode_one`. The wire shape `{input_name: <str | list[str]>}` normalizes to `dict[str, list[str]]` once at descriptor parse time. `_encode_one` passes `accepts_batch=("png_base64_batch" in encodings)` to the image encoder.
- `IMAGE_PNG_BASE64_BATCH` is already in `client.CLIENT_CAPABILITIES` (was added when the output-side decoder shipped) so no wire-header change.

## Verification

- Both modified files parse cleanly via `ast.parse`.
- The output-side `_decode_image_batch_envelope` already in this file consumes the same `frames=[…]` shape the new encoder emits — round-trips symmetrically.

## Lockstep

Paired server PR (must merge together): https://github.com/Comfy-Org/comfy-rnp-server/pull/12

No back-compat between unmatched server/client versions — the per-provider descriptors that previously narrowed `input_serialization` to single-string `"png_base64"` now use `["png_base64", "png_base64_batch"]`, and the schema_hash changes accordingly.

Amp thread: https://ampcode.com/threads/T-019e29b4-d606-7278-8584-52910661c981
